cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(OriginalSpdSystem LANGUAGES CXX)
add_executable(spd_system_checks checks.cpp)
target_compile_features(spd_system_checks PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
set_target_properties(spd_system_checks PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
option(SPD_SYSTEM_ASAN "Validate original buffers with AddressSanitizer" OFF)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(spd_system_checks PRIVATE /utf-8 /W4 /WX)
    if(SPD_SYSTEM_ASAN)
        target_compile_options(spd_system_checks PRIVATE /fsanitize=address /Zi)
        target_link_options(spd_system_checks PRIVATE /INCREMENTAL:NO /DEBUG)
    endif()
else()
    target_compile_options(spd_system_checks PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
endif()
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME original_spd_system_checks COMMAND spd_system_checks)
